activity_summary: Late, Anne counted four shillings aloud, one by one, and said those should come home. She did not name the rest of the purse, and she did not give a coffer total. She gave you a shirt turned at the collar. She did not ask her question again.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Repeated the four shillings and did not offer a fourth answer.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Counted the four that should come home, and gave back the shirt.

facets.activity: Heard Anne count four shillings that should come home

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: A shilling. A shilling. A shilling. And a shilling. These four come home.

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not asking thee the question.
